🌿✨ JUST LISTED in Copperas Cove! ✨🌿

Dreaming of a home with timeless farmhouse charm? 🏡 This beautifully maintained 1948 gem has it ALL!

⭐ 1102 S 5th Street, Copperas Cove, TX
💰 $235,000
🛏️ 4 Bedrooms | 🛁 3 Bathrooms | 📐 2,586 Sq Ft

👇 Take a peek at what makes this one special:

🔹 Corner Lot: Spacious and private!
🔹 Bright & Airy: Sunlight pours through abundant windows 🌞
🔹 2 Dining Areas: Perfect for entertaining & gatherings
🔹 Meditation Room: A peaceful spot to recharge 🧘‍♀️
🔹 Separate Laundry Room: Everyday convenience made easy
🔹 Massive Yard: Extend your dreams beyond the fenceline—gardens, play spaces, or pure relaxation 🌳
🔹 Termite Protection: Professionally maintained by Orkin 🛡️
🔹 Classic Meets Modern: Vintage character + thoughtful updates

This is the home where memories are waiting to be made! ❤️
